# Calls that omit arguments the callee takes, repaired with the caller's own incoming parameters (tools/gen_port.py
# apply_passthrough_calls). Generated by tools/verify_passthrough.py from the retail asm; see docs/prototype_audit.md.
# unit<TAB>function<TAB>callee<TAB>call number in the function's body (1-based)<TAB>argument list<TAB>evidence
# A row whose callee is @param gives the function parameters: the fourth column is how many it has now (the definition must
# match), the fifth the parameters appended (void *); every declaration of it in the tree follows.
# No active rows: the complete audited input chains are expressed upstream.
# The guarded 00513380 reconstruction also has its real input; its PS2 ASM fallback remains.
